stage: prospective protocol after development diagnosis; not registered formal evidence
task: Complete 360 source verification cards and one Kafka/SQL consistency memo
intended_use: Source-grounded research draft for human review; not deployment guidance or certified product guarantees
bulk_error_rule: Count each distinct card with any incorrect verdict, unsupported/contradicted factual prose, omitted necessary qualification, or invalid/non-supporting citation once. Editorial issues that do not change meaning remain recorded, not factual errors.
coverage_gate: All 360 distinct requested cards delivered; valid required fields and nonempty prose; missing or duplicate cards reject the whole task regardless of percentage.
critical_gate: All seven M2 answers and complete reason/counterexample/repair must pass the unchanged source-and-assumption rubric. No material error in the critical memo is allowed.
quality_symmetry: Use the exact same threshold, corrected reference, full artifact review and counting rule for mixed and all-Astra arms.
review: Root analyst reads every delivered card and full memo against frozen inputs; unblinded evaluation and evaluator effort are disclosed. Finite checks alone cannot establish semantic quality.
economic_gate: For every fully accepted fresh formal pair, mixed complete delivery USD upper bound <= 0.112 * all-Astra complete delivery USD lower bound; include all subject attempts/retries and Jev. Three pre-registered pairs must all pass. User relaxed the prior 90% objective to 88.8%.
allowed_claim: At least 98% source-card accuracy, fully correct critical memo, and measured complete-task API-equivalent savings if all formal gates pass; publish actual scores of both arms and all known error IDs.
forbidden_claims: Quality is exactly identical to all-Astra
90% measured savings before complete matched formal evidence
Errors can be patched without counting the repair model call
